items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: the next night Teddy and Peanuts and Jack Lesberg and the drummer, we had a sextet

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I was telling you that in 19 -- I think it was in the early '30's, I recorded a few things for Brunswick, kind of a tinkly sort of xylophone solos, and they'd gone pretty well -- they were kind of little blues and little solo I'd written, couple of things I'd written for the day. But I really wanted to record some four-hammer things on marimba, which they wouldn't let me. So, I decided to go ahead and try it, see if I could get it in.

So, I had Herb Spencer doing a little cut out with a guitar, bass -- bass clarinet and I made it playing it on marimba. So I didn't think Jack would go for it, so we set the date late at night. At 11:00 o'clock at night, which they used to do in those days --
